name: Sakura Mau Otome no Rondo ~Anata to Miru Fuyuzakura~
original_name: 桜舞う乙女のロンド ～あなたと見る冬桜～
source:
A mini fan disc featuring the top 2 characters from the popularity poll!
This game, which depicts events after the main story, allows you to play the following two newly written stories.

Character Popularity Poll #1: "Sakura-san's Licking Begins!?"
Aoi is celebrating New Year's in Japan for the first time in a long while.
As Aoi enjoys a date with Sakura, who is dressed in a kimono, he realizes that it's been a long time since he's eaten Osechi or Ozoni.
At that moment, Sakura suggests, "Shall I make some ozoni (Japanese New Year's soup)?"
The two of them eat ozoni (rice cake soup) in the empty Ouka Dormitory.
Then, as they enter Aoi's room, Sakura starts licking Aoi's ear...

Character Popularity Poll 2nd Place: "Aoi and Yuri's Secret Relationship"
Time has passed since the chaos of the Cherry Blossom Festival, and Aoi and Yuri are now in their third year of high school.
Yuri confessed her feelings and became Aoi's girlfriend.
However, their relationship had to remain a secret from everyone.
However, someone noticed a subtle change in the two of them.
And then, a package arrives for Aoi and Yuri.　
When I opened it, I found a wedding bouquet inside.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014800.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一张迷你粉丝光盘，收录了人气投票中排名前2位的角色！
该游戏描绘了主要故事之后的事件，允许你玩以下两个新编写的故事。

角色人气投票#1：“小樱小姐的舔开始了！？”
葵很久以来第一次在日本庆祝新年。
当葵与穿着和服的小樱约会时，他意识到自己已经很久没有吃御节或恶佐尼了。
这时，小樱提议道：“要不要我做点ozoni（日本新年汤）？”
两人在空荡荡的樱花宿舍里吃着年糕汤。
然后，当他们进入葵的房间时，小樱开始舔葵的耳朵……

角色人气投票第2名：《葵与尤里的秘密关系》距离樱花节的混乱已经过去了，葵和尤里现在已经是高中三年级了。
尤里坦白了自己的感情，并成为了葵的女朋友。
然而，他们的关系必须对所有人保密。
然而，有人察觉到两人身上发生了微妙的变化。
然后，葵和尤里收到了一个包裹。　
当我打开它时，我发现里面有一束结婚花束。
